summary.zh: 给出可执行的评审意见，及早发现缺陷
summary.en: Give actionable review feedback and catch bugs early

description.zh: 提供 PR 评审的检查清单与沟通方式，帮助指出缺陷、统一风格并促进知识共享。适合制定团队评审标准，或在评审中给出更有建设性的反馈。
description.en: Review checklists and phrasing that surface bugs early, keep style consistent, and spread context across the team. Useful for setting review standards or giving more actionable PR feedback.
